findings.detail:
Every suite stays green when the trigger refuses every Unaccounted row (so B13's balance check could never book its gap), and when it stops watching `kind` (so an adjustment in Unaccounted can be updated into a hand-picked spend). pgTAP only checks the refusals. The behaviour itself is right today (phase 4).

OF category_id ON transactions`. Fresh DB, migrate, `pg_prove test/*.sql` (and `pnpm test:db`).

findings.title: `transactions.my_share` defaults to NULL, not to `amount` as the spec says, and nothing records what NULL means
findings.detail:
Spec §7 and §15: `my_share` defaults to `amount`. The column has no default: a spend inserted without a share stores NULL. Postgres can't default one column to another, so this needs either a trigger or a written convention ('NULL is the whole amount'). Every spending reader from B09 on must then coalesce. Neither the schema comment nor a decision says so. The balance view uses `amount`, so B08's figures are right.

Run 4 scoped: fixed. D149, spec §7 and §15, and the schema comment say NULL is the whole amount; pgTAP pins it; no code reads my_share yet
findings.repro: As app_user: INSERT INTO transactions (..., amount, kind, source) VALUES (..., 123, 'spend', 'manual') RETURNING coalesce(my_share::text,'NULL')
findings.evidence: AC13 my_share defaults to amount?:  NULL

findings.title: Still unexplained (run 3's finding 6): the harness times More → Accounts at about twice main, and my probes don't
findings.detail:
Flags `step:balance-check/1` (settle 1101 ms median vs main 535), `step:first-run/20` (1314 ms, no main) and `step:balance-check/5` (Save back to Accounts, 1080 ms, no main: main's walk fails on '5 accounts') are the same screen opening. Measured outside the harness on the same dist-qa builds (service worker warm, CPU 4×, 150 ms/200 KB/s): time to 'In N accounts' and the last DOM change are equal, warm, cold or tapped at once. Head's tap loads 10 chunks against main's 2, all served by the service worker and finished within 192 ms of the tap on both sides (CDP Network.loadingFinished), with no DOM change after 600 ms. The filmstrip shows More unchanged for ~450 ms, then the slide and skeleton, with content by ~700 ms. The harness takes `last` from a mutation or a fetch in the tap's window, and what sets it here isn't recorded. Tooling ask: write which signal (mutation target or fetch URL) set each step's settle.

Run 4 scoped: not fixed (as the coordinator said); not re-measured.

findings.title: Every invalid field draws its label and message in destructive red, which patterns §2 forbids for an error
findings.detail: Patterns §2: destructive is 'never for an amount or an error: an error is said in words, in the text colour'. Changing Field is a shared-component change (a full run), or patterns §2 should say field errors may be red: a spec question for the owner.
